question: In which of the following economic accounts are transfer payments included?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Government account.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Transfer payments** are included in the **government account** of economic accounts.
 
• Transfer payments are payments made by the government to** individuals or businesses **without any expectation of goods or services in return.
 
• Examples of transfer payments include **social security, welfare, and unemployment** benefits.
 
• The inclusion of transfer payments in the government account helps in measuring the government's role in **income redistribution **and social welfare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **household account **refers to the **income and expenditure** of households.

 
 
• **Parents and kids** who live with you are considered immediate family members and can use the account.
 
 
 
• The **appropriation account **refers to the **allocation and utilization of funds** by the government for specific purposes such as infrastructure development or defense spending.
 
 
• An appropriation account for a business indicates how** profits are allocated** and held.
 
• It displays the way in which **profits are split **up among partners in a partnership.
 
 
 
• The **production account **refers to the value of goods and services produced by different sectors of the economy.
 
 
• It is designed for both **industry and institutional** sectors.
 
 
 
• **Transfer payments **are an important tool for governments to address** income inequality** and provide a safety net for vulnerable sections of society.
